book.name: 2 Koriyn
book.title: 2 KORIYN Pol Minj Kisen Koriyn Biynimb Kuyip Tikak

content: Biynimb Gor Ker Mindpay Gok Direp Ginimimb
Pen biynimb Gor ker mindpay gok direp ginimimb aspiyn minim ak, nimb key niŋrep gipim.
Nimb Akaya propens mindpim gok, simiy nind ak, opriyŋ kun ak gos key niŋiy ñiniŋg gembik; yand am biynimb Masedoniya propens mindpay okok kuyip, aŋgenik niŋiy; miñiy biynimb kuŋaynep opriyŋ ñispay.
Pen mam gunap kuyip nimbip nind yoksipiyn ak; opriyŋ dayrep gem mey, Masedoniya kay kuyip aŋgnik ak, minim nep aŋgip aŋgiy ma niŋniŋgiy.
Pen maniy ma nan-geniŋgambim; Masedoniya biynimb gunap poŋind amjaken, minim nep aŋgnik rek, chinup nambiŋ giniŋgamb. Nimbip kunep ginimuŋ rek ayip.

Kun ak mam chin gok kuyip nind aŋgyoksipiyn. Kiyk am nimb yip mindiy, maniy ñiniŋgambun apik ak, nan-gem mindonimuŋ. Kisen yand Masedoniya biynimb gunap yip amjakiy, gos nimb key niŋiy opriyŋ ñimbim ak niŋrep giniŋgambay.
Nimb niŋbim: biynimb tap yiŋ kuŋay ma yimbay gok, tap kuŋay ma mindeniŋgamb; biynimb tap yiŋ kuŋay yimbay gok nep, tap kuŋaynep mindeniŋgamb.
Kun ak nimb biynimb nokom nokom mindpim rek, gos key niŋiy opriyŋ ñinimimb. Yiruk gakniŋ ma ñinimimb. Biynimb gunap nimbip nembnemb gey niŋiy, ma ñinimimb. Key niŋbim rek, tep gakniŋ ñinimimb.

Pen Gor Biyomb mindip ak nimbip bilesiyŋ ñiniŋg, tap tikdiniŋgamb rek nep ma ñiniŋgamb; gos nuk key niŋiy, tapin ñinimuŋ rek mindip. Kun ak mey tap nimb kuŋaynep mindakniŋ, woŋg tep nup ar keykey minek minek ginimimb rek ayniŋgamb.
Minim kun ak rek, Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: “Biynimb an biynimb simbgeprek gok kuyip, tap monmon ñiniŋgambay ak, Gor biynimb tep yand aŋgiy, niŋyiŋg nep mindeniŋgamb aŋgyak.”

content: Gor chinup per tap yiŋ ñiy, keñmaŋgiy ñiy gip ak; nimbip tap yiŋ kuŋay yimb ñiniŋgamb. Pen nuk gek jakrep geniŋgamb, nimb diy gunap biynimb bilok ñem mey, tep yimb ginimuŋ rek ayip.
Nimbip per gek, tap nimb kuŋaynep mindek, monmon ñemb rek ayniŋgamb ak mey; tap ñiyiŋg mindem, chin dand amiy biynimb gunap ñon, Gor nup yimb ak dand araniŋgambay.

Gor nup chiŋgiy, direp giniŋgambim kun ak, biynimb gok sek direp geniŋgambim mey; Gor nup yimb ak dand aranyiŋg aŋgniŋgambay, “Kiyk Krays minim tep ak pisnep diy, chinup monmon ñiy, biynimb okok kuyip monmon ñiy gipay ak; nip tep yimb aspun aŋgniŋgambay.”
Pen Gor nimbip simb niŋiy direp yimb gip rek niŋiy, gos kiyk am nimbip kom kom gek tep gakniŋ, Gor nup aŋgniŋ mindeniŋgambay.
Pen chinup Ñi tep yimb nuk ak monmon yokek apiy kumak ak; nup yimb dand aranjun.
